rules.numeric_sources: all numeric tracking values from frozen R5.2.2 profile, exact R5.2 suspect/confirm fields only; no runtime scenario constants
rules.material: abs(new_command - previous_qualified_command) >= profile material_command_delta AND profile model predicts finite threshold-crossing released response; no arbitrary runtime horizon
rules.not_observable: profile model cannot reach minimum observable displacement for this command magnitude; do not infer actuator failure from this demand alone
rules.initial_reference: if no prior PLC command, compare first PLC command with the released measured speed; no fabricated pre-takeover command
rules.epoch_start: on observable material demand when no active directional epoch or upon observable material reversal
rules.watch_start: first unresolved observable material demand; anchor to released measured speed and retain oldest causal time
rules.small_update: update latest command only; epoch and watch timestamps and suspicion count unchanged
rules.same_direction_material: retain directional epoch and watch start; update latest command; watch maximum observable step is max(previous, abs(current command - watch anchor speed)); do not reset suspicion
rules.reversal_after_motion: close old directional epoch and resolved watch; new directional epoch/watch anchor to current released valid speed
rules.reversal_without_motion: replace directional epoch and re-anchor its direction; retain watch anchor, oldest age, maximum observable step and suspicion count; no new watch grace
rules.response_open: first released sample at which profile lag/ramp/delay model predicts minimum observable displacement from the demand; watch uses oldest unresolved time and maximum observable step
rules.progress: released VALID speed displacement from current directional anchor in expected direction >= profile minimum observable change and R5.2 suspect progress ratio >= frozen 0.5; qualified motion resolves current watch
rules.suspect: after profile response opening and frozen R5.2 expected progress >= 0.03, absent directed qualified progress or progress ratio < 0.5
rules.confirm: frozen R5.2 expected progress >= 0.12 and ratio < 0.35 for exactly 2 consecutive qualified valid samples; carried watch age and deficit count cannot reset on command changes
rules.steady: valid measurement and abs(latest command - released measured speed) <= profile tracking-error tolerance after qualified progress; mark epoch resolved and remain eligible for future material demand
rules.suspected_recovery: qualified released directional progress with ratio >= 0.5 before confirmation returns to TRACKING_PROGRESS; time or command update alone cannot recover
rules.confirmed_recovery: confirmed qualifier remains latched for audit; restored motion may be recorded but only existing top-level Safety reset/recovery authority can clear FAULT
rules.sensor_invalid: visible status INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENT; preserve directional epoch, watch, oldest age and previous valid deficit count; invalid samples never confirm
rules.sensor_recovery: first valid released sample is evaluated against preserved anchor/command/watch age; no new epoch or grace solely from telemetry recovery
rules.continuous_monitoring: qualified progress is not permanent immunity; later observable material demand creates new obligation even after progress or steady completion
rules.no_unobservable_permanent_fault_claim: if command trajectory never offers a profile-observable persistent demand, no universal hardware stuck guarantee is claimed

invariants: small updates cannot reset oldest demand age
progress/steady do not grant permanent immunity
invalid measurement never replaced by raw ACTUAL
confirmed tracking fault never auto-clears top-level Safety FAULT
material reversal creates deterministic new direction without erasing no-motion evidence
